schema.description: One indoor session on a Technogym machine (rower or stair climber), shaped as an IEEE 1752 physical-activity-1.0 payload with Technogym's other measures beside it in snake_case. The extractor records/extract/technogym_json.py in anam-importers writes a records file from a Technogym mywellness export, one record per session, and the records importer sends it. Values are Technogym's own, apart from the start time and activity name, which the extractor derives. A Garmin Cardio session often spans the machine sessions done during it, so a sum across the leaves counts that time twice. This is the Technogym leaf of activity.exercise-session: Technogym's own payload shape, named for its vendor (card 192), so a reader asks about exercise across the leaves by the prefix activity.exercise-session. and knows which shape each fact has. Version 1 is activity.exercise-session v2 cut to the fields Technogym writes, each with the same rules, and its facets came across in card 195's rename (renames/vendor-leaves.json), each the next version of itself with its payload unchanged. The shared core, id, activity_name, effective_time_frame and source, is the same on all four leaves of activity.exercise-session (internal/def/shared-core.json). Version 2 adds source_time (card 198), declared and not required, every other rule unchanged.

activity_name.description: The IEEE 1752 activity name, chosen by the extractor: rowing.machine for a session with a rowing distance, stair_climbing.machine for one with floors.

average_cadence.description: Average stroke rate, as an IEEE 1752 cadence: Technogym's AvgSpm.

value.description: The source's average stroke rate, as reported.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute: Technogym's AvgHr.

avg_peak_force.description: Technogym's AvgPeakForce, as reported. A single rowing session in the export carries it, reading zero, so its meaning and unit are not settled by the source.

avg_power_w.description: Average power in watts: Technogym's AvgPower.

base_movement_quantity.description: The stroke count, as an IEEE 1752 movement count: Technogym's IsoReps. Rowing sessions only: the stair climber reports no IsoReps.

value.description: The source's stroke count, as reported.

calories_consumption.description: Technogym's CaloriesConsumption, the session's energy rate in kcal per hour: wherever it appears it equals Calories divided by the duration in hours.

distance.description: Distance covered in metres: Technogym's RowingDistance, metres rowed.

drag_factor.description: The rower's drag setting, as reported: Technogym's DragFactor.

drive_perc.description: Technogym's DrivePerc, as reported. A single rowing session in the export carries it, reading zero, so its meaning and unit are not settled by the source.

duration.description: The session's net duration in seconds: Technogym's Duration, the same figure the interval's duration holds.

effective_time_frame.description: When the session happened, as an IEEE 1752 time interval.

duration.description: The session's length in seconds: Technogym's Duration.

value.description: Seconds, a whole or decimal number.

start_date_time.description: The start, ISO 8601 with offset, to the second, derived by the extractor: the export's `on` (the session's end) minus its Duration. This is the fact time.

facility.description: Technogym's facility id, an opaque identifier for the site whose machine logged the session. It repeats on every session at one site, and the export does not name the site.

floors.description: Technogym's Floors, floors climbed on the stair climber, as reported.

id.description: The records row's id: technogym: and the export's `on` timestamp, verbatim.

kcal_burned.description: Energy burned in kcal: Technogym's Calories.

level.description: Technogym's Level, the machine's resistance level, as reported. A split's level is a whole number; the session's can be fractional, a figure Technogym computes that is close to, but not exactly, the mean of its splits' levels.

max_hr_bpm.description: Peak heart rate in beats per minute: Technogym's MaxHr.

max_power_w.description: Peak power in watts: Technogym's MaxPower.

max_spm.description: Technogym's MaxSpm, peak stroke rate in strokes per minute.

mets.description: Technogym's Mets, which despite the name holds MET-minutes: on every session with both, it equals mets_min times the session's minutes. The extractor has left it out since version 2 (Matt: a bespoke measure), so only facets written by version 1 carry it, each since superseded by a version without it. Checked on the live record, 2026-10-10 and again at card 195: no live facet carries it. It stays on this leaf so a records file written by extractor version 1 still validates.

mets_min.description: Technogym's MetsMin, which despite the name holds the session's MET rate, mets divided by the session's minutes; on stair climber sessions vo2 is exactly 3.5 times it. The extractor has left it out since version 2, so only facets written by version 1 carry it, each since superseded by a version without it. Checked on the live record, 2026-10-10 and again at card 195: no live facet carries it. It stays on this leaf so a records file written by extractor version 1 still validates.

move.description: Technogym's Move, its own activity score in what Technogym calls MOVEs, as reported. Technogym does not say how it is computed, and it tracks neither calories nor duration alone.

ph_id.description: Technogym's phId, an opaque identifier kept as written. It is not unique per session: every session done as the same workout shares one (sessions under a phId share a target distance or time), and the export does not name the workouts.

source.description: Which app the session came from: always "Technogym mywellness", written by the extractor.

split_500m_sec.description: Technogym's RowingSplit, pace per 500 m in seconds.

splits.description: Per-split measures for the session, in the export's order.

items.description: One split, each measure a plain number.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate for the split, beats per minute: Technogym's AvgHr.

avg_spm.description: Average stroke rate for the split, strokes per minute: Technogym's AvgSpm.

distance_m.description: Distance for the split, metres: Technogym's RowingDistance.

duration_sec.description: Duration of the split, seconds: Technogym's Duration.

kcal.description: Calories for the split, kcal: Technogym's Calories.

level.description: Level for the split, the machine's resistance level.

max_spm.description: MaxSpm for the split, strokes per minute.

position.description: The split's position in the session, from 1: the export's `pos`.

split_500m_sec.description: RowingSplit for the split, seconds per 500 m.

strokes.description: IsoReps for the split, a stroke count.

user_weight_kg.description: Technogym's UserWeight, the body weight entered on the machine, in kilograms.

vo2.description: Technogym's Vo2, estimated oxygen uptake in ml/kg/min: it is exactly 3.5 times the session's MET rate (1 MET = 3.5 ml/kg/min), so it is derived, not measured. The export has it on stair climber sessions only.

source_time.description: How Technogym's clock was read (card 198): value is Technogym's on, when the session ended, with the offset Technogym wrote (basis source); the start is on less the session's Duration, so value is the end and not the fact time. Not required: the records were extracted before card 198, and Technogym has no export left to extract again.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
